name: Task resolution success rate
definition: Share of eligible production runs resolved and independently verified without human takeover within the task SLA.
formula: count(distinct run_id where verified_success = true and human_takeover = false) / count(distinct eligible run_id)

numerator.definition: Distinct eligible runs with verification_passed=true and human_takeover=false before task SLA expiry.

denominator.definition: All distinct eligible production runs started in the window, including failed, timed-out and escalated runs.

data_source.query: SELECT run_id, max(verified_success) AS verified_success, max(human_takeover) AS human_takeover FROM canonical_agent_events WHERE event_type IN ('run.completed','run.verified') GROUP BY run_id

alert.condition: 7d ratio < 0.75 OR 95% Wilson upper bound < 0.80 after minimum_sample
actions: compare with frozen baseline by scenario stratum

confidence.decision_rule: PASS only when denominator >= 200 and lower confidence bound >= target; report INCONCLUSIVE otherwise.
